'''Ruehn''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Alanciari military]], stationed at the fort at [[Garrow's Neck]]. At some point he lost one of his eyes, leaving him with one good one. When [[Quarra Thayn]] was traveling to [[Point Defiance]] to visit [[Jogan Halder]], he stopped her and asked for her documents. When she showed him her letter of transit and commission, he was taken aback because he didn't realize she was a [[wardmaster]].<ref name="pandemonium" />
